scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:railway: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w backend
scripts.build:vercel: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w landing && npm run build -w frontend && node scripts/merge-vercel-output.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.pack:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm --prefix desktop run pack
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm --prefix desktop run dist
